Jewish Studies (JWST)

Overview

The Jewish Studies minor introduces students to Jewish history, thought, and lifeways, through the millennia and around the globe. Students take courses introducing the religion and its languages, then choose electives across the humanities and social sciences. Any student in any bachelor's program may add the minor.

Requirements for a Minor in Jewish Studies

JWST 2003Introduction to Judaism3
JWST 3103Introduction to Jewish Languages3
JWST 4003Modern Jewish Thought3
Total Hours15
